page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.large is an x86_64 cloud server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. Configured with 1 physical CPU core supporting hyperthreading for a total of 2 vCPUs, it is paired with 4.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Cache architecture consists of 48 KB L1d cache, 1 MB L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI, VAES, SHA-NI, and BMI2. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor with 1 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and includes no bundled local SSD storage or GPU acceleration.

Benchmark results demonstrate moderate single-core efficiency paired with limited multi-threaded throughput due to the single physical core topology. Single-threaded performance achieves an average stress-ng single-core score of 1858.29, a Geekbench single-core score of 1559.0, and a gzip compression speed of 27.69 GB/sec. Multi-threaded evaluations show lower relative placement, recording a Geekbench multi-core score of 1813.0 and a stress-ng multi-core score of 1932.77. Uncached memory bandwidth measures 14.89 GB/sec for reads and 13.52 GB/sec for writes, while PassMark memory scoring registers at 1251.63.

With dedicated CPU core allocation, this instance provides predictable compute availability without CPU credit throttling mechanisms. The hardware profile offers an economical entry-level solution for low-concurrency operations. It is best suited for lightweight web serving, small microservices, text processing tasks, and basic background utility scripts that require stable execution on a minimal resource footprint.
